description: Pins a new note (a call script, a rule of thumb) to the Ops Summary's Team reference card, as Add note does: title and content_md (Markdown; the words an office person should follow). A repeat of the same Save returns the note it made. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. Edit it with edit_team_reference_note, remove it with remove_team_reference_note.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_team_reference_note
title: Add a Team reference note
